system.description:
Instead of concealing or disguising the vampire or an object, this power removes a victim's sense of direction. He literally cannot see which way to go, forcing him to move in circles and binding him to an area of the vampire's choosing. The vampire can trap a person in his own home: from the victim's point of view the house folds back on itself, and all exits lead back inside.

You must win a Mental Challenge against the target to establish a Mental Maze. Normally the power affects a multi-room structure or an outdoor area of similar size; a much larger area reduces the difficulty and extends the duration to a full day. Trapping a victim within a single room, or affecting a supernatural victim (werewolf, mage, other vampire or ghoul), requires expending a Willpower Trait.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
system.duration: Full scene (up to a full day for a large area)
